mapper.insert: INSERT INTO object_deletion_queue ( workspace_id, object_key, attempts, delete_passes_remaining, next_attempt_at ) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{objectKey}, 1, #{deletePassesRemaining}, #{nextAttemptAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts = LEAST(object_deletion_queue.attempts + 1, 2147483647), next_attempt_at = IF( VALUES(delete_passes_remaining) > object_deletion_queue.delete_passes_remaining, GREATEST(object_deletion_queue.next_attempt_at, VALUES(next_attempt_at)), LEAST(object_deletion_queue.next_attempt_at, VALUES(next_attempt_at)) ), delete_passes_remaining = GREATEST( object_deletion_queue.delete_passes_remaining, VALUES(delete_passes_remaining) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND delete_passes_remaining = 2
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
DELETE FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND object_key = #{objectKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE object_deletion_queue SET attempts = LEAST(attempts + 1, 2147483647), delete_passes_remaining = delete_passes_remaining - 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND delete_passes_remaining > 1
